evidence_items.explanation: Citing two people familiar with the deliberations, the report says prospective H200 buyers would probably have to justify why domestic suppliers could not satisfy their requirements. That proposed preference supports protectionism as a contributing motive, while the explicit caveat limits the finding to deliberations.
